1998-03-06 minus 37 weeks = 1998-03-06 minus 259 days.  
259 days + 1 day = 260 days before 1998-03-06.  
1998 is not a leap year, so count back:  
From 1998-03-06: back 6 days to 1998-02-28 (28 days in Feb 1998), back 31 days to 1998-01-28, remaining 260 - 37 = 223 days earlier into 1997.  
Actually simpler: 260 days = 365 - 105 → going back from 1998-03-06 to 1997-06-19? Let's compute directly:  

1998-03-06 minus 260 days:  
1998-03-06 back 6 days → 1998-02-28  
Back 28 more days → 1998-01-31  
Back 31 more days → 1997-12-31  
Remaining days = 260 - 6 - 28 - 31 = 195 days left in 1997.  
From 1997-12-31 back 195 days:  
Dec: 0, Nov: 30, Oct: 31, Sep: 30, Aug: 31, Jul: 31, Jun: 30.  
Sum: 30+31+30+31+31+30 = 183 days (to 1997-07-01).  
195 - 183 = 12 more days back from 1997-07-01 → 1997-06-19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1997-06-19
